backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. One function body replaced with the same signature; two new union branches read existing history tables. No data touched.

forward_verification.name: function_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'admin_audit_feed_v1'

forward_verification.name: staff_details_branch_present
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%staff_details_history%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'admin_audit_feed_v1'

forward_verification.name: companion_branch_present
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%guest_companion_history%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'admin_audit_feed_v1'

rollback.safe_until: always - a function body only, no data touched

feature_flags.name: admin_audit_history
feature_flags.required_state: Settings > Audit history already calls admin_audit_feed_v1; no client change needed, staff_details and companion edits simply start appearing.

compatibility.evidence: Two more union all branches over existing history tables; every prior branch's SQL is unchanged.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
